They are published in deference to, and compliance with, the strong wishes of many who heard them delivered.

arxiv-2304-14327.title: Quantum oscillations in 2D electron gases with spin-orbit and Zeeman interactions
arxiv-2304-14327.creator: Denis R. Candido, Sigurdur I. Erlingsson, Hamed Gramizadeh, João Vitor I. Costa, Pirmin J. Weigele, Dominik M. Zumbühl, J. Carlos Egues
arxiv-2304-14327.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Denis R. Candido, Sigurdur I. Erlingsson, Hamed Gramizadeh, João Vitor I. Costa, Pirmin J. Weigele, Dominik M. Zumbühl, J. Carlos Egues. Shubnikov-de Haas (SdH) oscillations are the fingerprint of the Landau and Zeeman splitting level structure on the resistivity in presence of a moderate magnetic field before full quantization is manifest in the integer quantum Hall effect.

arxiv-2410-03789.title: Benchmarking Turbulence Models to Represent Cloud-Edge Mixing
arxiv-2410-03789.creator: Johannes Kainz, Nikitabahen N. Makwana, Bipin Kumar, S. Ravichandran, Johan Fries, Gaetano Sardina, Bernhard Mehlig, Fabian Hoffmann
arxiv-2410-03789.description: Abstract Considering turbulence is crucial to understanding clouds. However, covering all scales involved in the turbulent mixing of clouds with their environment is computationally challenging, urging the development of simpler models to represent some of the processes involved. By using full direct numerical simulations as a reference, this study compares several statistical approaches for representing small-scale turbulent mixing.

arxiv-2508-18866.title: Asymptotic Properties of a Forward-Backward-Forward Differential Equation and Its Discrete Version for Solving Quasimonotone Variational Inequalities
arxiv-2508-18866.creator: Yeyu Zhang, Hongwei Liu
arxiv-2508-18866.description: Abstract This paper investigates the asymptotic behavior of a forward-backward-forward (FBF) type differential equation and its discrete counterpart for solving quasimonotone variational inequalities (VIs). Building on recent continuous-time dynamical system frameworks for VIs, we extend these methods to accommodate quasimonotone operators. We establish weak and strong convergence under significantly relaxed conditions, without requiring strong pseudomonotonicity or sequential weak-to-weak continuity.

arxiv-2510-08158.title: Beyond Over-Refusal: Scenario-Based Diagnostics and Post-Hoc Mitigation for Exaggerated Refusals in LLMs
arxiv-2510-08158.creator: Shuzhou Yuan, Ercong Nie, Yinuo Sun, Chenxuan Zhao, William LaCroix, Michael Färber
arxiv-2510-08158.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shuzhou Yuan, Ercong Nie, Yinuo Sun, Chenxuan Zhao, William LaCroix, Michael Färber. Warning: Some examples include unsafe, sensitive, or potentially harmful content. Large language models (LLMs) frequently produce false refusals, declining benign requests that contain terms resembling unsafe queries.

arxiv-2511-17393.title: Designing and Generating Diverse, Equitable Face Image Datasets for Face Verification Tasks Journal: Image and Vision Computing
arxiv-2511-17393.creator: Georgia Baltsou, Ioannis Sarridis, Christos Koutlis, Symeon Papadopoulos
arxiv-2511-17393.description: Abstract Face verification is a significant component of identity authentication in various applications including online banking and secure access to personal devices. The majority of the existing face image datasets often suffer from notable biases related to race, gender, and other demographic characteristics, limiting the effectiveness and fairness of face verification systems.

pmc-11772399.title: Deciphering cellular complexity: advances and future directions in single-cell protein analysis
pmc-11772399.creator: Qirui Zhao, Shan Li, Leonard Krall, Qianyu Li, Rongyuan Sun, Yuqi Yin, Jingyi Fu, Xu Zhang, Yonghua Wang, Mei Yang
pmc-11772399.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Single-cell protein analysis has emerged as a powerful tool for understanding cellular heterogeneity and deciphering the complex mechanisms governing cellular function and fate. This review provides a comprehensive examination of the latest methodologies, including sophisticated cell isolation techniques (Fluorescence-Activated Cell Sorting (FACS), Magnetic-Activated Cell Sorting (MACS), Laser Capture Microdissection (LCM), manual cell picking, and microfluidics) and advanced approaches for protein profiling and protein-protein interaction analysis.

pmc-12427463.title: Diagnosis, Treatment, and Unmet Needs of Dedifferentiated Liposarcoma in the United States: A Multidisciplinary Delphi Study
pmc-12427463.creator: David Campbell, Scott Ramsey, David Veenstra, Minggui Pan, Shiraj Sen, Gregory Litton, Bruce Brockstein, Shawn Young, Andrew Fang, Parth Shah
pmc-12427463.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryDedifferentiated liposarcoma (DDLPS) is a rare disease with limited treatment options and poor prognosis. A Delphi study with clinical experts across the United States convened to generate consensus statements on the diagnosis, treatment, and unmet needs of DDLPS. Panelists reached agreement on the preferred first-line and subsequent treatments currently available, and emphasized the need for novel treatments with improved efficacy and safety.

pmc-12584276.title: Analysis of genetic diversity among wild soybean (Glycine soja) from Hengshui Lake in Hebei Province, China
pmc-12584276.creator: Xintong Wu, Qike Feng, Zhanying Zhang, Xinyue Zhang, Zhi Liu, Qing Yang, Xiaolei Shi, Mengchen Zhang, Long Yan
pmc-12584276.description: ObjectivesSoybean serves as a crucial source of protein and oil. Wild soybean (Glycine soja) shares genetic similarities with cultivated soybean (Glycine max) but exhibits richer diversity due to lower genetic bottlenecks. The high allelic diversity in wild soybeans provides traits for environmental adaptation, which is useful for cultivated soybeans through breeding.

pmc-12670780.title: Plastome comparison and phylogenomic analysis of threatened wild Egyptian Capparis taxa
pmc-12670780.creator: Norhan Amar, Heba A. M. AbdAlla, Qing-Feng Wang, Mohamed Abd. S. El Zayat, Hager R. Belal, Sheng-Wei Wang, Tao Wan, Mohamed Hamdy Amar, Jun-Nan Wan
pmc-12670780.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundCapparis is one of the largest genera in the Capparaceae family, it is currently classified as comprising threatened wild plants in Egypt. The taxonomy of Capparis remains ambiguous due to complex classifications, overlapping morphological traits, and regional variability. Herein, we present, for the first time, the complete plastome genome sequences of five threatened Capparis taxa from Egypt, all belonging to Capparis spinosa, including one subspecies and several varieties.

pmc-12732781.title: Advances in the Application of Nanocomposite Hydrogels in Crops
pmc-12732781.creator: Diego Gael Hernández-Echave, Gonzalo Casillas-Moreno, Andrés Isaí Romo-Galindo, Tonantzin Anahí Gutiérrez-Gómez, Gilberto Velázquez-Juárez, Moyses Alejandro Rodríguez-Ortega, Rubén Octavio Muñoz-García, Diego Alberto Lomelí-Rosales, Sergiu Coseri, Jana Čopíková, Ioana A Duceac
pmc-12732781.description: Conventional agricultural practices, based on intensive irrigation and heavy fertilizer and pesticide inputs, are increasingly incompatible with climate change, soil degradation, and sustainability goals. Hydrogels have emerged as promising soil amendments to improve water and nutrient management, and fall broadly into two categories: synthetic polyacrylate/polyacrylamide-based systems and natural biobased hydrogels derived from polysaccharides such as alginate, cellulose, and chitosan.

pmc-12970020.title: Informing China’s “Weight Management Year” with Global Evidence: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Community-Based Strategies
pmc-12970020.creator: Yan Zhang
pmc-12970020.description: BackgroundThe “Weight Management Year” (2024–2026) is a key national policy in China that prioritizes community-based strategies to combat the growing obesity epidemic. However, a comprehensive synthesis of global evidence on the effectiveness of community-led interventions, which could inform the implementation of this policy, remains lacking.MethodsWe conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis following PRISMA guidelines.

pmc-12993232.title: Effects of fermentation time and sugar type on the processing characteristics and quality of special low-protein steamed sponge cakes
pmc-12993232.creator: Ye Zi, Cuiping Shi, Zhenfeng Liu, Wei Cai, Jian Zhong
pmc-12993232.description: The development of special low-protein foods has gained significant attention in medical and food science research. There is a notable lack of research on these foods with protein contents under 1 g/100 g. This study aimed to develop special low-protein steamed sponge cakes (LPSSCs) and analyze the effects of fermentation time and sugar type on their properties.

pmc-13092343.title: Prevalence and Risk Factors for Esophageal Strictures in Systemic Sclerosis
pmc-13092343.creator: Alannah Quinlivan, Dylan Hansen, Wendy Stevens, Nava Ferdowsi, Susanna Proudman, Jennifer Walker, Joanne Sahhar, Gene‐Siew Ngian, Diane Apostolopoulos, Lauren V. Host, Chamara Basnayake, Kathleen Morrisroe, Laura Ross, Mandana Nikpour
pmc-13092343.description: ObjectiveGastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) affects up to 90% of patients with systemic sclerosis (SSc). Chronic esophageal acid exposure can result in complications including the formation of esophageal strictures (ES). Proton pump inhibitors can alter gastric acid pH and improve GORD symptoms; however, there have been no recent studies evaluating the prevalence of SSc–ES since these medications became widely available.

pmc-13145528.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026YS52 PREVALENCE AND INDEPENDENT PREDICTORS OF AUGMENTED RENAL CLEARANCE IN ACUTE STROKE PATIENTS: PRELIMINARY RESULTS OF THE NEURO-ARC STUDY
pmc-13145528.creator: Maged Kharouba, Sherif Mahmoud, Demetrios Kutsogiannis, Aaron Cook, Melissa Bastin
pmc-13145528.description: Background and aimsPatients with acute stroke [Ishcemic stroke (IS), intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH), and subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH)] are at risk for augmented renal clearance (ARC), a hyperfiltration state (creatinine clearance (CLCR) >130 mL/min/1.73m2) that can cause therapeutic failure due to subtherapeutic drug levels. Because standard laboratory markers often fail to identify ARC, clinical recognition is vital to avoid complications.

pmc-13201565.title: Understanding and modelling ammonia partitioning and transport across reverse osmosis membrane
pmc-13201565.creator: Zhijie Wang, Kai Yang, Subhamoy Mahajan, Ying Li, Mohan Qin
pmc-13201565.description: Reverse osmosis (RO) is increasingly applied for the reclamation of ammonia-rich wastewater. However, the mechanisms governing NH3/NH4+ transport across RO membranes remain unclear. In this study, we develop an ammonia partitioning and transport (APT) model to quantitatively describe NH3/NH4+ retention and transport, incorporating pH-dependent NH3/NH4+ partitioning and membrane charge variation.

pmc-13222553.title: Refractory Periungual Warts Treated with Filiform Fire Needle Combined with Warming-Yang and Collateral-Dredging Chinese Medicine Soak: A Two-Case Report
pmc-13222553.creator: Shanguang Lyu, Zhenzhen Chong, Tao Yu, Chen Ruan
pmc-13222553.description: RationalePeriungual warts, caused by Human Papillomavirus (HPV) infection, are a therapeutic challenge due to their proximity to the nail matrix and poor drug penetration. Conventional treatments, such as cryotherapy and laser, carry a high risk of nail damage and recurrence, highlighting the need for safer and more effective alternatives.

pmc-13430875.title: The effectiveness of nursing interventions for preventing postoperative delirium in older adults undergoing major orthopedic surgery: a systematic review
pmc-13430875.creator: Sunee Kraonual, Wichayaporn Thongpeth, Thaworn Thongpet
pmc-13430875.description: BackgroundPostoperative delirium (POD) frequently occurs in elderly patients after major orthopedic surgery. Nurses play a key role in delivering non-pharmacological preventive interventions, but the evidence supporting their effectiveness varies. This systematic review aims to summarize current research on nursing interventions designed to reduce POD in older adults undergoing these surgeries.

pmc-13435678.title: Phase I dose-ascending, safety, and pharmacokinetics study of APC148, a novel metallo-β-lactamase inhibitor, in healthy volunteers
pmc-13435678.creator: Bjørg Bolstad, Ragnar Hovland, Johan Bylund, Erik Rein-Hedin, Sandra Kuusk, Bjørn Klem, Pål Rongved

pmc-13490136.title: The relationship between sarcopenia detected in newly diagnosed lung cancer patients and serum levels of IL6, IGF-1 and myostatin
pmc-13490136.creator: Kamil Süzer, Utku Oflazoglu, Leyla Demir, Sinan Unal, Zeynep Gulsum Guc, Yasar Yildiz, Furkan Oguzhan Karalar, Yuksel Kucukzeybek, Ahmet Alacacioglu
pmc-13490136.description: AimSarcopenia can result from many factors, including cancer, and is a consequence of quantitative and qualitative deterioration in skeletal muscle mass. Although there are some hypothetical explanations for sarcopenia, the underlying mechanisms of this condition have not been clearly defined in cancer patients.

pmc-13613463.title: Reflectance-Only Retrieval of Refractive Index and Extinction Coefficient Dispersions in an Absorbing Thin Film via a Paul-Wavelet Repetition-Frequency Method
pmc-13613463.creator: Emre Coskun, Cansu Emir, Erhan Tiryaki, Makbule Terlemezoglu, Mehmet Parlak
pmc-13613463.description: Accurate knowledge of the refractive index (n) and extinction coefficient (κ) dispersions is essential for understanding the optical response of thin-film materials used in photovoltaics, optoelectronics, and related photonic applications. However, transmission-based dispersion extraction becomes unreliable for turbid, colloidal, nanostructured, or strongly absorbing thin films, where low transmission or scattering prevents accurate spectral evaluation.

pmc-13688885.title: Plant growth regulator diethyl aminoethyl hexanoate suppresses Aspergillus flavus growth and aflatoxin biosynthesis through disruption of redox homeostasis
pmc-13688885.creator: Kai Ouyang, Lei He, Yarong Zhao, Siyi Tan, Guanxian Chen, Yingwen Wu, Xinyu Han, Xiaorong Wan, Qingqing Zhi
pmc-13688885.description: Aflatoxin B₁ (AFB₁), produced by Aspergillus flavus, is a major threat to food safety and human health. In this study, we report that diethyl aminoethyl hexanoate (DA-6), a plant growth regulator, exhibits strong antifungal and anti-aflatoxigenic activities against A. flavus.
